_note: Volunteer drain programs by place. Status: open = public sign-up, pilot = limited area, none = no sign-up found (which is not proof there isn't one). Checked Nov 6, 2026. The app only links out: it never signs anyone up.

san-francisco.name: Adopt a Drain SF
san-francisco.detail: Pick a drain, name it, and get an email before large storms.

new-orleans.name: Adopt-A-Catch Basin
new-orleans.detail: Pick a basin on the city map, name it, and sweep the leaves and grass off it.

charleston.name: Adopt-a-Drain
charleston.detail: Keep the grate clear between city cleanings. You're never asked to clear inside a drain.

houston.name: Adopt-A-Drain
houston.detail: Adopt a drain near you and clear it about four times a year.

nyc.name: Adopt-a-Catch Basin
nyc.detail: Pilot in East Greenpoint, Brooklyn. Outside it, DEP takes your details and contacts you when it expands.

boston.detail: BWSC asks residents to adopt a nearby catch basin and clear snow from it, but we found no sign-up. Its site has a catch basin map.

norfolk.detail: A neighborhood pilot was reported in 2018. We found no current sign-up.

miami.detail: A local report said a program was coming. We found no sign-up.

sacramento.detail: We found no city or county program.
